description: A published Polyrank Builder ranking: masked top-25 + the weight/filter definition. Builder rankings are custom skill leaderboards (a weighting over the metric catalog plus filters) that users publish and share by slug. Returns the masked top-25 rows and the ranking’s weight/filter definition. Pass the slug from a shared /r/<slug> link.

slug.description: Published ranking slug from a /r/<slug> share link.

name: polyrank_get_custom_ranking
title: Polyrank published Builder ranking
